title: AMLO CDD identity controls
desc: Token and Identity Registry must expose the hooks necessary to perform customer and beneficial owner due diligence before onboarding.

title: AMLO record keeping support
desc: Identity Registry Storage must be wired and emit lifecycle events so identity evidence can be retained for at least seven years.

title: Sanctions and Blacklist Screening
desc: Smart contracts must enforce sanctions compliance by reverting transfers to addresses flagged by blacklist logic.

allOf.desc: Transfer to a random address should revert if blacklist logic is enforced

title: Ongoing Monitoring via Modular Compliance
desc: Smart contracts must enable modular compliance checks to enforce transaction surveillance, including country restrictions and monthly transfer limits.

allOf.desc: Transfer from blocked country or over monthly limits should revert due to active monitoring module

title: Ownership and Control Tracking
desc: Identity onboarding must require a Beneficial Owner claim topic and at least one trusted issuer so beneficial ownership can be evidenced via OnchainID claims.

title: Risk Classification Hooks
desc: Smart contracts should expose hooks to retrieve or assign a user’s risk category for ongoing monitoring.
snippet: function riskLevel(address investor) external view returns (uint8);

title: Identity Resolution Interface
desc: Contracts should support mapping from investor wallet address to identity contract for audit traceability.
snippet: function identity(address investor) external view returns (address);

title: Dual Control for Critical Actions
desc: Administrative smart contract actions such as freezing should require multiple signatures or roles.

allOf.desc: Freeze should fail if caller lacks proper role

title: Freeze and Unfreeze Capability
desc: Contracts must support freezing and unfreezing investor accounts in real time.

allOf.desc: Frozen address should not be able to transfer

title: KYC Status Revalidation
desc: System should revalidate investor KYC claims during runtime to avoid stale access.

allOf.desc: Transfer by unverified user should fail

title: Jurisdiction Screening
desc: Compliance module should reject transfers from investors in blocked countries.
snippet: CountryRestrictModule blocks based on msg.sender location.

allOf.desc: Transfer from blocked country should revert
